user: The George Washington Bridge
assistant: The George Washington Bridge, often abbreviated as GWB, GW, or simply the George, is a double-decked suspension bridge that spans the Hudson River. It connects the Washington Heights neighborhood of Manhattan in New York City with Fort Lee, New Jersey. The bridge is owned by the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey and, as of 2016, was the world's busiest motor vehicle bridge, carrying over 103 million vehicles per year.  In 1946 , two more lanes were created on the current upper level , widening it from the original six lanes . A second , lower deck , which had been anticipated in Ammann 's original plans , opened to the public on August 29 , 1962 . The lower level , nicknamed `` Martha '' after George 's wife Martha Washington , increased the capacity of the bridge by 75 percent , and simultaneously made the George Washington Bridge the world 's only 14 - lane suspension bridge. The George Washington Bridge has also been designated a National Historic Civil Engineering Landmark by the American Society of Civil Engineers. Unfortunately, it is also a common site for suicide attempts in the New York metropolitan area.

[The Start of Current Turn Question]
Are emergency vehicles  posted at the GW bridge?
[The End of Current Turn Question]

[The Start of Reference Answer]
Yes, the George Washington Bridge has emergency vehicles stationed 24/7 at the bridge such as fire trucks , rescue trucks , and wreckers specially designed for the GW Bridge for serious incidents , such as fires , vehicle extrications , Haz - Mat incidents , overturned vehicles , and many other emergencies . Emergency Medical Services are also provided by the Agents .The Port Authority Police Department (PAPD) is responsible for law enforcement and security at the bridge, and they have patrol vehicles and officers deployed there to respond to emergencies and ensure the safety of the commuters and the bridge itself.
[The End of Reference Answer]

[The Start of Document]
George Washington Bridge
Emergency services are provided by the Port Authority 's Tunnel & Bridge Agents , who are stationed at the bridge 24 / 7 and maintain various apparatus such as fire trucks , rescue trucks , and wreckers specially designed for the GW Bridge for serious incidents , such as fires , vehicle extrications , Haz - Mat incidents , overturned vehicles , and many other emergencies . Emergency Medical Services are also provided by the Agents .

 It was dismantled in 1967 and relocated to Arizona . The Arizona bridge is a reinforced concrete structure clad in the original masonry of the 1830s bridge , which was purchased by Robert P. McCulloch from the City of London . McCulloch had exterior granite blocks from the original bridge numbered and transported to America to construct the present bridge in Lake Havasu City , a planned community he established in 1964 on the shore of Lake Havasu . The bridge was completed in 1971 ( along with a canal ) , and links an island in the Colorado River with the main part of Lake Havasu City . The song `` London Bridge is Falling Down '' is a nursery rhyme that predates the bridge 's original 19th - century construction .

One World Trade Center
An estimate in February 2007 placed the initial construction cost of One World Trade Center at about $3 billion , or $1,150 per square foot ( $12,380 per square meter ) . However , the tower 's total estimated construction cost had risen to $3.9 billion by April 2012 , making it the most expensive building in the world at the time . The tower 's construction was partly funded by approximately $1 billion of insurance money that Silverstein received for his losses in the September 11 attacks . The State of New York provided an additional $250 million , and the Port Authority agreed to give $1 billion , which would be obtained through the sale of bonds . The Port Authority raised prices for bridge and tunnel tolls to raise funds , with a 56 percent toll increase scheduled between 2011 and 2015 ; however , the proceeds of these increases were not used to pay for the tower 's construction .
[The End of Document]
